name: Isabelle Leonard
title: Crisis communication specialist and media trainer
bio_short: Crisis communication specialist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience across public and private sectors in Europe. Winner of the European Sabre Award. Fluent in French, English, Dutch, Spanish and German.
bio: Isabelle is a crisis communication specialist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience working across public and private sectors in Europe. She began her career at the Guggenheim Museum in New York before returning to Brussels to work at Interel, one of Europe's leading public affairs and communications consultancies, where she specialised in crisis communication. In 2006, her work earned the European Sabre Award for best crisis management agency in Europe, widely regarded as the most prestigious recognition in the public relations industry.  Isabelle has managed real crisis situations at the highest level, and she brings this first-hand experience directly into her training. Her clients span financial services, transport, energy, environment and government sectors. She has served as chairwoman of the European Public Affairs Consultancy Associations, reflecting her standing in the European public affairs community.  At ISOC, Isabelle delivers crisis communication, corporate communications and media training programmes, and serves as a role-play journalist in media training simulations, bringing authentic newsroom pressure to practice sessions. Her five-language fluency in French, English, Dutch, Spanish and German makes her exceptionally effective in multilingual European and international environments. Isabelle is based in Brussels.
